messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content:
在這兩手牌中，兩位玩家都拿到了一手 **同花**（都是同一花色的五張牌），但並沒有順子或更高的牌型。  
比較同花時，從最高牌往下逐一比對：

| 牌序 | 約翰 | 邁克 |
|------|------|------|
| K    | ✔️   | ✔️   |
| Q    | ✔️   | ✔️   |
| J    | ✔️   | ✔️   |
| 10   | ✔️   | ✔️   |
| 9/8  | 8♥  | 9♠  |

邁克的第五張牌是 9♠，比約翰的 8♥ 高，因此邁克贏得了這局。  

**勝者：邁克**。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K hearts: that's a straight flush (8-9-10-J-Q-K? Wait missing 9♥). Straight flush requires consecutive ranks. John's cards: 8,10,J,Q,K. Missing 9. So not straight flush. It's a flush (all hearts) but not straight. He has high card K. Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠. That's also a flush (spades). Also missing 8♠. So both flushes. Compare highest card: both have K. Next: Q. Both same. Next: J. Both same. Next: 10. Both same. Next: 9 vs 8. Mike has 9, John has 8. So Mike wins with higher flush. So answer: Mike wins.
